result.instructions: Tools for inv.bg, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which invoices are still unpaid, oldest first?"; "Show everything I invoiced to client Acme OOD this year."; "Create a draft invoice for 3 hours of consulting at 80 BGN plus 20% VAT for client 1042.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes inv.bg data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run invbg_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run invbg_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run invbg_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. invbg_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: invbg_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The company (id, name, subdomain) and the user the API token belongs to. GET /account.

tools.name: invbg_get_firm
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: The issuing company's details: name, Bulstat, VAT registration and VAT number, address, MOL, contact email, custom properties. GET /firm.

tools.name: invbg_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List documents (tax invoices, proformas, debit and credit notes) with filters: type, number, issue-date range, amount ranges, payment status, client, draft/annulled, sent status, currency. Each row has number, client, totals, balance_paid, balance_due and dates. GET /invoices.

type.description: Document types: dan = tax invoice, prof = proforma, deb = debit note, cred = credit note.

date_from.description: Only documents dated on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

date_to.description: Only documents dated on or before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

amount_gt.description: Only documents with a total of at least this amount.

amount_lt.description: Only documents with a total of at most this amount.

amount_due_gt.description: Only documents with an outstanding balance of at least this amount.

amount_due_lt.description: Only documents with an outstanding balance of at most this amount.

status.description: Payment statuses to include. Use ["unpaid", "partially-paid"] to find open receivables.

client_id.description: Only documents issued to this client (invbg_list_clients).

client_name.description: Client name filter; % matches any run of characters, _ one character.

is_draft.description: true = only drafts, false = no drafts.

is_annulled.description: true = only annulled documents, false = none.

order_by.description: Field to sort by (for example id, date or name; see the vendor reference).

language.description: Language of names in the reply: bg (default) or en, where the record has both.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: invbg_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: One document by id: number, type, issuer and recipient, line items, VAT, totals, balance_paid and balance_due, dates, bank accounts, sent/confirmation status. Optionally with its comments. GET /invoices/{id}.

invoice_id.description: inv.bg document id (the id field of invbg_list_invoices, not the printed number).

language.description: Language of names in the reply: bg (default) or en, where the record has both.

tools.name: invbg_list_invoice_types
tools.title: List document types
tools.description: All document types of this company (tax invoice, proforma, debit/credit note and any custom types) with their codes. GET /invoices/types.

tools.name: invbg_get_next_invoice_number
tools.title: Get next invoice number
tools.description: The next free document number of the default number set for a document type. Read-only: it does not reserve the number. GET /invoices/free-number.

tools.name: invbg_list_number_sets
tools.title: List number sets
tools.description: The company's invoice number sets (separate numbering series) with ids; pass an id as number_set to invbg_create_invoice. GET /invoices/number-sets.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: invbg_list_payment_methods
tools.title: List payment methods
tools.description: The payment method codes a document accepts (cash, bank, card, ...) with their names. GET /invoices/payment-methods.

language.description: Language of names in the reply: bg (default) or en, where the record has both.

tools.name: invbg_list_vat_exemption_reasons
tools.title: List VAT exemption reasons
tools.description: The legal reasons for issuing a document without VAT (use one as vat_exemption_reason in invbg_create_invoice). GET /invoices/without-vat-reasons.

language.description: Language of names in the reply: bg (default) or en, where the record has both.

tools.name: invbg_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List or search clients (customers): name, Bulstat, VAT number, address, MOL, whether it is a person. GET /clients.

is_person.description: true = individuals only, false = companies only.

order_by.description: Field to sort by (for example id, date or name; see the vendor reference).

language.description: Language of names in the reply: bg (default) or en, where the record has both.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: invbg_get_client
tools.title: Get client
tools.description: One client by id with all stored details (names in both languages, Bulstat, VAT, address, MOL, code, custom properties). GET /clients/{id}.

language.description: Language of names in the reply: bg (default) or en, where the record has both.

tools.name: invbg_list_client_contacts
tools.title: List client contacts
tools.description: Contact people of a client (or of all clients) with their names and roles. GET /client-contacts.

client_id.description: Only the contacts of this client.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: invbg_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: The product/service catalogue: name, price, currency, unit, tags. GET /items.

order_by.description: Field to sort by (for example id, date or name; see the vendor reference).

language.description: Language of names in the reply: bg (default) or en, where the record has both.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: invbg_get_item
tools.title: Get item
tools.description: One catalogue item by id. GET /items/{id}.

language.description: Language of names in the reply: bg (default) or en, where the record has both.

tools.name: invbg_list_item_units
tools.title: List units of measure
tools.description: Units of measure accepted as quantity_unit on items and invoice lines. GET /items/units.

language.description: Language of names in the reply: bg (default) or en, where the record has both.

tools.name: invbg_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: Recorded payments (income and expense) with amount, method, date, counterparty, how much is allocated to invoices (amount_used) and what is left (amount_left). GET /payments.

paid_from.description: Paid on or after this date.

paid_to.description: Paid on or before this date.

amount_gt.description: Amount of at least this value.

amount_lt.description: Amount of at most this value.

contragent.description: Counterparty name; % matches any run of characters.

is_expense.description: true = expenses only, false = income only.

order_by.description: Field to sort by (for example id, date or name; see the vendor reference).

language.description: Language of names in the reply: bg (default) or en, where the record has both.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: invbg_get_payment
tools.title: Get payment
tools.description: One payment by id with its allocations to invoices (invoice_payments). GET /payments/{id}.

tools.name: invbg_list_bank_accounts
tools.title: List bank accounts
tools.description: The company's bank accounts (alias, bank, IBAN, BIC, currency). GET /bank/accounts.

language.description: Language of names in the reply: bg (default) or en, where the record has both.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: invbg_list_bank_transactions
tools.title: List bank transactions
tools.description: Imported bank transactions with amount, date, counterparty, and whether they are linked to a document. Useful for reconciliation (linked=false = unmatched). GET /bank/transactions.

type.description: deb = debit (money out), cred = credit (money in).

date_from.description: On or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

date_to.description: On or before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

amount_gt.description: Amount of at least this value.

amount_lt.description: Amount of at most this value.

linked.description: true = only transactions linked to documents, false = only unlinked ones.

order_by.description: Field to sort by (for example id, date or name; see the vendor reference).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: invbg_list_cashboxes
tools.title: List cashboxes
tools.description: The company's cash registers (cashboxes) with names and balances. GET /cashboxes.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: invbg_get_exchange_rate
tools.title: Get exchange rate
tools.description: The exchange rate of a currency to BGN on a date (default: today), as inv.bg uses it for documents. GET /currency/rates/{currency}.

currency.description: Currency, ISO 4217 code such as BGN or EUR.

tools.name: invbg_create_client
tools.title: Create client
tools.description: WRITE: add a company client (name, Bulstat, VAT, address, MOL). Check invbg_list_clients first to avoid a duplicate. For an individual (EGN) issue the document with invbg_create_invoice and is_to_person instead. POST /clients.

is_reg_vat.description: Whether the company is VAT-registered (default false).

vat_number.description: VAT number; required when is_reg_vat is true.

country.description: Country name or code as inv.bg stores it, e.g. BG.

tools.name: invbg_update_client
tools.title: Update client
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing client (only the fields you pass are changed). PATCH /clients/{id}.

tools.name: invbg_create_item
tools.title: Create item
tools.description: WRITE: add a product or service to the catalogue (name, price, unit). POST /items.

tools.name: invbg_create_invoice
tools.title: Create invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create a document (tax invoice by default; proforma, debit/credit note via type). It is saved as a DRAFT unless draft is false: an issued document takes the next legal number and cannot be undone through this tool. Address it to an existing client_id, or give to_name + to_address (+ to_mol and to_bulstat for a company, to_egn for a person) and inv.bg matches or creates the client from those details (an existing client matched by Bulstat or VAT number is UPDATED with the address, MOL and other details you pass). VAT: set vat_percent on the document, or on every item. POST /invoices.

type.description: dan = tax invoice (default), prof = proforma, deb = debit note, cred = credit note.

draft.description: Save as a draft (default true). Pass false to issue the document and consume its number.

client_id.description: Existing client id (invbg_list_clients). Then the to_* fields are ignored.

is_to_person.description: true when the recipient is an individual (then to_egn is needed).

to_egn.description: Recipient EGN, 10 digits (individuals), as text so leading zeros survive.

to_is_reg_vat.description: Whether the recipient company is VAT-registered.

to_vat_number.description: Recipient VAT number (needed when to_is_reg_vat is true).

to_mol.description: Recipient accountable person (MOL); required for companies when no client_id.

name.description: Item name as printed on the invoice.

price.description: Price per unit (without VAT unless items_with_vat is true).

quantity_unit.description: Unit of measure, e.g. pcs, hours (see invbg_list_item_units).

vat_percent.description: VAT rate for this item in percent (20 is the standard Bulgarian rate). Needed on every item unless the invoice sets vat_percent.

reduction_percent.description: Discount on this item in percent.

vat_percent.description: VAT rate for the whole document in percent; ignored where items carry their own vat_percent.

vat_exemption_reason.description: Why no VAT is charged (when VAT is 0); see invbg_list_vat_exemption_reasons.

items_with_vat.description: true if item prices already include VAT (default false).

currency_rate.description: Exchange rate to BGN (BGN/XXX). Required when currency is not BGN: take it from invbg_get_exchange_rate.

number_set.description: Number set id to take the number from (invbg_list_number_sets); omit unless you use several series.

reduction_percent.description: Discount on the whole document in percent.

tools.name: invbg_send_invoice_email
tools.title: Email invoice
tools.description: WRITE: email a document to a recipient (as a download link or an attached file). The email goes out immediately and cannot be recalled. POST /invoices/{id}/emails.

name.description: Recipient name used in the text.

message.description: Message text placed in the email.

delivery.description: link = a download link (default), file = attached PDF.

language.description: Language of the document (default: the document's own).

tools.name: invbg_record_invoice_payment
tools.title: Record invoice payment
tools.description: WRITE: record a payment received for a document and allocate it, which updates the document's balance_paid/balance_due and payment status. Two calls: POST /payments, then POST /payments/{id}/invoices. If the allocation fails the payment stays recorded: the error names its id (see invbg_get_payment).

invoice_id.description: inv.bg document id the payment is for.

amount.description: Amount received and allocated to this document.

currency.description: Currency of the payment (required by inv.bg), e.g. BGN or EUR.

currency_rate.description: Exchange rate to BGN (required by inv.bg): 1 for BGN; otherwise the rate from invbg_get_exchange_rate.
